description: This Java class defines configuration logic for Kafka authentication, specifically handling SASL mechanisms and creating JAAS configuration strings based on connection credentials.

classes.name: KafkaAuthenticationSpecificConfig
classes.description: Provides mechanisms to configure Kafka SASL authentication, including validation and application of credentials.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of KafkaAuthenticationSpecificConfig.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks if the connection has the necessary credentials for SASL authentication.

methods.name: validateOrThrow
methods.description: Validates the connection's SASL configuration; throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks whether the connection's SASL configuration is valid.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies SASL configuration to Kafka producer properties using the connection credentials.
